gold_routing_table.routing_rationale: Urgent design clarifications escalate directly to the Mechanical Engineer for a fast resolution.
Simultaneous cost and schedule impact routes to the Cost/Change-Order Manager to evaluate the change before technical resolution.
gold_routing_table.divergence_reason: This project's change-order protocol pulls the cost manager in whenever a Mechanical design clarification carries both cost and schedule impact at priority urgency; other discipline/RFI-type combinations on this project route the same cost-and-schedule condition to the Owner's Representative instead. At urgent urgency, this template routes directly to the Mechanical Engineer regardless of cost/schedule, matching this project's urgent-escalation convention.

gold_routing_table.routing_rationale: Default discipline routing: the Mechanical Engineer resolves design clarifications affecting mechanical work.
